free_tier.stated: 'Free gives you one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine to run every month at no cost', quoted, with 5 snapshots, the standard agent-browser template, auto-pause after 30 idle minutes, and the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB or 4 vCPU / 8 GiB sizes allowed. Pro is USD 20 a month and Team USD 500, each including usage equal to its fee. Accounts created before 2026-10-20 keep five free machines until 2026-12-01

retention.stated: The five-machine grant is a legacy state with a printed end date of 2026-12-01, so the 20 vCPU / 40 GiB figure that circulated in October 2026 expires in six weeks and the steady state is 4 vCPU / 8 GiB.

egress.terms: Free plan: 100 GiB of egress a month, then USD 0.02 per GiB; ingress is free. Separately, a machine's upload is capped at about 50 Mbit/s per VM.
egress.free_allowance: 100 GiB a month on the Free plan (Pro 1 TiB, Builder 5 TiB, Team 50 TiB)
egress.price_per_tb: USD 0.02 per GiB beyond the allowance (USD 20.48 per TiB)

interface_detail: HTTP API with an API key, the instabox CLI, SSH through a gateway (certificate or SSH token), a TypeScript SDK (@insforge/instabox-sdk), an MCP server and a web dashboard
tooling: the instabox CLI and the TypeScript SDK @insforge/instabox-sdk (npm), authenticated with an API key (INSTABOX_API_KEY)
chaining: One 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine with persistent files and snapshots is a place to hold a working set between sessions, which a notebook that resets does not give.

notes: Two corrections in one record. The count moved from 5 to 1, and the 8 GiB size is not reliably creatable even on the free plan: the Japanese review reports the 8 GiB option refused at creation time. What is not established is whether the invite waitlist is still the entry route now that the product has paid plans; the changelog describes a dashboard billing page and does not mention the waitlist. The changelog of 2026-10-20 states the plan table directly: one free 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine a month, never billed, with the five-machine grant retained only for accounts created before that date and only until 2026-12-01.
